systems.system: Social Health Authority Health Management Information System (SHA HMIS)
systems.owner: Social Health Authority and Digital Health Agency, under the Ministry of Health
systems.tiers: 5,078 facilities operating on it, 2,978 of them submitting claims electronically (levels not given)
contracted providers, to be migrated off it

note: A Ministry of Health release of 29 June 2026. It describes the SHA HMIS by real-time patient verification, electronic claims management, provider authentication and information exchange with facilities' own hospital systems; it does not say it holds the clinical record or carries aggregate reporting, so the class is empty and there is no fact. Figures carried: 11,034 facilities accredited by SHA; 6,228 public facilities, stated as 93 per cent, 'digitally transformed' (not defined); 5,078 on the SHA HMIS; 2,978 submitting claims electronically.
